landing.title: Know what to do on your farm today
landing.lead: FasalAlert checks the weather forecast against your crop's growth stage and its damage limits, then gives you one clear action, a deadline and the sources behind it. In Marathi, Hindi or English.
landing.point.phone: Sign in with your mobile number, no password
landing.flow.caption: How a decision is made
landing.flow.weatherSub: Open-Meteo, ECMWF 51-member ensemble and JMA, refreshed through the day
landing.flow.stageSub: Worked out from your sowing date and growing degree days
landing.flow.limitsSub: Frost and heat thresholds for each stage, cited from ICAR and university sources
landing.flow.chanceSub: With how well the model is shown to work
landing.flow.sourcesSub: Forecast, model and advisory, with times
landing.features.title: What FasalAlert does
landing.features.sub: One place for the decisions that depend on weather, crop stage, roads and markets.
landing.f.decisionBody: For each field: what to do, by when, how sure we are and why. When the data is not good enough, FasalAlert says so and points you to your KVK.
landing.f.frostBody: A model trained on 75 years of IMD temperature grids estimates the chance of crossing your crop's limit in the next 72 hours.
landing.f.rainBody: The share of 51 ECMWF forecasts that give 64.5 mm or more in a day, the IMD heavy-rain level.
landing.f.transportBody: How exposed the road from your field to the mandi is to rain, from rainfall and terrain. It is an estimate, not a report of closed roads.
landing.f.marketBody: AGMARKNET prices for nearby mandis when a data.gov.in connection is set up. No prices are shown without real data.
landing.f.askBody: Type or speak a question. Answers use your field's data and quote verified advisories, with links.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.s1Body: Enter your mobile number and the 6-digit code we send by SMS. A new number creates an account.
landing.how.s2Body: Choose your district, taluka and village, the crop and the sowing date. The map is optional.
landing.how.s3Body: Home shows what matters today for each field, with the deadline and the sources.
landing.how.s4Body: Alerts arrive on the channels you turn on. Ask a question any time.
landing.crops.title: Supported crops
landing.crops.sub: Six crops with cited stage calendars and damage limits. Values are sourced but not yet reviewed by an agronomist.
landing.voice.title: Ask in Marathi, Hindi or English
landing.voice.body: The assistant answers questions about your fields from FasalAlert's own models and a library of agricultural advisories. It does not make up advice.
landing.voice.p1: Quotes verified advisories and links the source
landing.voice.p2: Says when it has no verified advice and gives your KVK's number
landing.voice.p3: Answers only farming questions about your fields
landing.voice.note: Typed questions always work. Spoken questions need a speech service (Bhashini) connected to the server.

landing.trust.title: Sources and limits
landing.trust.sub: What FasalAlert uses, how it handles uncertainty, and what it cannot do.
landing.trust.d1: Forecasts: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), ECMWF IFS ensemble, JMA
landing.trust.d2: Training data: IMD gridded temperature, 1951 to 2025
landing.trust.d3: Crop stages and limits: ICAR, state agricultural universities
landing.trust.d4: Roads: OpenStreetMap and OSRM; terrain: SRTM
landing.trust.d5: Boundaries: geoBoundaries (ODbL); prices: AGMARKNET when connected
landing.trust.m1: Each frost and heat estimate says whether the model's skill has been shown at that threshold.
landing.trust.m2: When data is stale or advice cannot be verified, FasalAlert gives no recommendation instead of a guess.
landing.trust.m3: Answers are put together from fixed templates and quoted sources. No AI text generator writes them.
landing.limits.title: Important limits
landing.limits.l1: FasalAlert supports your judgement and your KVK's advice. It does not replace them.
landing.limits.l2: At most crop thresholds, the frost and heat model's accuracy is not yet proven. Treat those estimates as early.
landing.limits.l3: Road risk is estimated from rainfall and terrain. It does not know about actual closures.
landing.limits.l4: Market prices appear only when the AGMARKNET data connection is set up.
landing.limits.l5: Crop values are cited but not yet reviewed by an agronomist.

settings.help.decision: the coloured level is how serious the risk is, the chance is how likely it is, and the deadline is when to act. Open "Why this" to see the numbers and sources.

calib.description: Adjust how FasalAlert warns you for one field.
calib.guide.title: What these settings do
calib.guide.intro: They change when and at what temperature FasalAlert warns you for the chosen field. Most farmers can keep the defaults.
calib.guide.sensitivityBody: Higher sensitivity warns at lower chances, so you get earlier warnings and more false alarms. Lower waits for higher chances. Default: normal.
calib.guide.limitsBody: The temperature at which your crop is damaged at its current stage. The default comes from the cited crop table. Change it only if your experience or your KVK says this field differs. Allowed: frost -10 to 20 °C, heat 25 to 55 °C.
calib.guide.leadBody: How many hours before a risky window you want the reminder. Allowed: 6 to 168 hours. Default: 24 hours.
calib.guide.statusBody: Defaults are cited from ICAR and university sources but not yet reviewed by an agronomist. A value you set is your own estimate and is marked as changed on the field page.
calib.guide.effectBody: The next decision for this field uses the new values. It is recalculated in the background, usually within a minute.
